project.name: PDF-Bench - PDF-to-Markdown Benchmarking Suite
project.description: Open-source benchmarking suite for evaluating PDF-to-Markdown conversion systems with commercially permissive licensing
project.notes: Added pdfplumber (TASK-086, 3h) and Databricks (TASK-087, 6h) parsers. Cancelled Nougat tasks (TASK-031, TASK-032, -6h). Net change: +3 hours. Total tasks: 87 (85 original + 2 new).
